children: Abu Dhabi-listed Sharjah Islamic Bank (SIB) priced its $500 million five-year sukuk after attracting more than $1.2 billion (excluding JLM interest) in investor orders, allowing it to tighten pricing by 30 basis points from initial guidance.
The UAE lender priced the Reg S senior unsecured sukuk at a profit rate of 5.85%, equivalent to105bp over five-year US Treasuries; tightening from around UST+135bp area.
The sukuk was issued by SIB Sukuk Company III, with Sharjah Islamic Bank acting as obligor. The notes were priced at par and carry a periodic distribution rate of 5.85%.
The sukuk is rated A- by S&P Global Ratings, in line with Sharjah Islamic Bank's issuer rating. The bank is rated A-/BBB+ by S&P and Fitch, respectively.
Standard Chartered acted as a bookrunner on the transaction.
The debt will be listed on Euronext Dublin and Nasdaq Dubai.
(Writing by Brinda Darasha; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Sharjah Islamic Bank prices $500mln sukuk as demand tops $1.2bln
